name: Law2_ScGeom_MindlinPhys_Mindlin

attributes.name: includeAdhesion
attributes.description: bool to include the adhesion force following the DMT formulation. If true, also the normal elastic energy takes into account the adhesion effect.

attributes.name: calcEnergy
attributes.description: bool to calculate energy terms (shear potential energy, dissipation of energy due to friction and dissipation of energy due to normal and tangential damping)

attributes.name: includeMoment
attributes.description: bool to consider rolling resistance (if eta is 0.0, no plastic condition is applied.)

attributes.name: timingDeltas

methods.name: contactsAdhesive
methods.description: Compute total number of adhesive contacts.

methods.name: ratioSlidingContacts
methods.description: Return the ratio between the number of contacts sliding to the total number at a given time.

methods.name: normElastEnergy
methods.description: Compute normal elastic potential energy. It handles the DMT formulation if Law2_ScGeom_MindlinPhys_Mindlin::includeAdhesion is set to true.
